comparison.objective: Choose fitting tweezers and peel protective film while stabilizing its carrier, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool selection, tweezer pinch, deformable peeling, bimanual holding, and tool return versus rigid hex-tool engagement, rotary adjustment, torque locking, and cycle inspection.
comparison.success_condition: Film fully removed, carrier controlled, film laid outside, and tools returned versus two safe damped stops with retained setting.
comparison.reason: This validated deformable peeling task does not test adjustable damping or fastener retention. No spec versions are present; holder-placement tolerances and final peel threshold are not fully numeric in the body.
